before-runtime-profile.label: before-runtime-profile
command:
import runpy,subprocess,sys
try:
 script=sys.argv.pop(1)
 runpy.run_path(script,run_name="__main__")
except subprocess.CalledProcessError as error:
 print("RECORDER STDOUT:",error.stdout,file=sys.stderr)
 print("RECORDER STDERR:",error.stderr,file=sys.stderr)
 raise
